comment:
The fixed cost of hosting the minimum starting set of components may exceed what is affordable for small states and countries in fragile settings. 

Also, there are already several acronyms in the document (e.g. DPI, DPI-F, DPI-H, full-STAC, DIIG, DHP, and now REDDHI).

public.suggestedRevision:
Options for a shared or regional model for REDDHI may be explored.

If the concept of REDDHI is “the minimum shared foundation of DPI-H", then perhaps it can just be named descriptively (e.g. DPI-H foundational core) rather than introducing another acronym.
